newsitem.title: INDIA: India National exchange limits trading hours.
newsitem.headline: India National exchange limits trading hours.

text.p: The National Stock Exchange (NSE) will limit trading hours on Wednesday due to technical problems, a NSE official told Reuters.
The NSE will start trade at 10:15 a.m. (0445 GMT) and close at 11.45 a.m. (0615 GMT).
The session will be limited to square-up business which normal ends on Tuesday. Trading for the new account will begin on Thursday, the official said.
Weekly auctions of outstanding positions will be done at 12.15 p.m. (0645 GMT), he said.

Satellite problems had forced the NSE to revise trading hours from last week to between 9.30 a.m. (0400 GMT) and 3.00 p.m. (0930 GMT). The exchange normally runs from 10.00 a.m. (0430 GMT) to 3.30 p.m. (1000 GMT).
